pages.text: Elemental mobs fight differently from ordinary ones.$(br2)$(li)They carry $(thing)splash potions$() and throw them at you.$(li)They $(thing)flee$() from steam clouds and auras instead of standing in them.$(li)They can trigger $(l:elementalcraft:reactions/counters)Elemental Counters$(/l) when badly hurt.

pages.title: What they throw
pages.text: About $(thing)35%$() of elemental mobs are given a potion in their off hand. Which potion depends on their element, and it is always designed to set up their own reaction:$(br2)$(li)$(#c00)Fire$() mobs throw $(thing)splash Poison$(). Poison makes Scorched last 50% longer and hit 50% harder.$(li)Everyone else throws $(thing)splash Water$(), to wet you before Frost, Thunder or their own element lands.$(br2)They only throw when they have line of sight and you are within 12 blocks, up to three bottles per volley.

pages.title: Farming enchanted books
pages.text: Killing elemental mobs is the intended way to build your own elemental gear:$(br2)$(li)Base drop chance $(thing)50%$(), $(thing)+10%$() per Looting level.$(li)The book is randomly an Aspect, an Enhancement or a Resistance book.$(li)Its level roughly matches the mob's own power - hunt the 80-100 point elites for level IV-V books.$(br2)Their armour never drops, so books are the only reward.

pages.title: Fighting them
pages.text: $(li)Match your element to theirs using the $(l:elementalcraft:basics/restraint)restraint cycle$(/l) - a Frost mob resists Fire, so bring Nature or Thunder.$(li)Get wet before fighting a Frost mob and you are handing it a Freeze.$(li)Do not let a spore-infected friend stand next to you: the blast chains.$(li)Mobs that are fleeing a steam cloud are free hits - steam clears their aggro entirely.
